observations.text: The camera initially frames legs and torsos below a reflective waterline that obscures both faces. Faces emerge as the women sink farther underwater. The held blade points upward and then across the other woman.

The black-clad woman reaches toward the other shoulder. The white-clad woman raises an empty open palm as the arm withdraws, but the inspected frames do not establish a clear wrist redirection. The sword remains separately held across the lower composition.

Both hands lower and the women remain near one another. The continuing push-in crops the sword and much of the first woman; a clear drift-apart hold is absent. Bubbles, floating hair and tiled surroundings remain readable, with no motorcycle or extra person.
